task.text:
[0] Male mice with GHR knockout had lower insulin and higher adiponectin levels in plasma and improved glucose tolerance, and improved lifespan. The maximum and minimum life expectancy are indicated by survival curves (90th and 10th percentile, respectively). The numbers of animals are approximate according to the survival curves, the article states that there were 23-43 animals in each group.

[1] Ames dwarf mice with GHR knockout had improved lifespan compared with wild type. The maximum and minimum life expectancy are indicated by survival curves (90th and 10th percentile, respectively). The numbers of animals are approximate according to the survival curves, the article states that there were 23-43 animals in each group.

[2] Ames dwarf mice with GHR knockout had improved lifespan compared with wild type. The maximum and minimum life expectancy are indicated by survival curves (90th and 10th percentile, respectively). The numbers of animals are approximate according to the survival curves, the article states that there were 23-43 animals in each group.

[3] GHRH knockout mice were smaller and had more adipose tissue than control. GHRH knockout mice exhibited major shifts in the expression of genes related to xenobiotic detoxification, stress resistance, and insulin signaling.

[4] GHRH knockout mice were smaller and had more adipose tissue than control. GHRH knockout mice exhibited major shifts in the expression of genes related to xenobiotic detoxification, stress resistance, and insulin signaling.

[5] GHRH knockout mice were smaller and had more adipose tissue than control. GHRH knockout mice exhibited major shifts in the expression of genes related to xenobiotic detoxification, stress resistance, and insulin signaling.

[6] Calorie restriction diet enhanced the positive effect of GHRH knockout on the mice lifespan.

[7] Calorie restriction diet enhanced the positive effect of GHRH knockout on the mice lifespan.

[8] Calorie restriction diet enhanced the positive effect of GHRH knockout on the mice lifespan.

[9] GHRHR lit/lit mice are deficient in pituitary growth hormone and lived longer than +/lit control on a low-fat diet, suggesting that the changes of GH/IGF-1 axis affect lifespan.

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
